speaker: Doctor
text: How old are you, and what specific activities or injuries have preceded the swelling in your right knee? Additionally, has your family been diagnosed with gout, pseudogout, or early-onset osteoarthritis?

speaker: Patient
text: 18-month-old boy. The patient is brought in by his parents due to swelling in his right knee noticed after playing in the park. The parents report that there was no obvious injury or incident at the park that could have led to the swelling. Upon further questioning, the mother recalls that an uncle on her side of the family had similar problems, suggesting a possible genetic component.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Juvenile Idiopathic Arthritis (likely Oligoarticular type) or Hemophilia A (given the age and traumaless onset). REQUEST TEST: Coagulation Profile (PT, aPTT, Factor VIII), Rheumatoid Factor, ANA, and Knee_Ultrasound.
